name: Receding-Horizon Native-Discriminator Consensus for HJ
observed_failure: HJ's own gate/risk cannot distinguish beneficial and harmful states
unsb_object: full optimizer-state transition under the native fake-discriminator component
derivation: From the same immutable full state S_k, compute B0=Phi_0^8(S_k) and Bi=Phi_hj^8(S_k). Let Delta=D_fake(Bi)-D_fake(B0). Commit Bi iff Delta>0; otherwise commit B0.
identity_condition: Delta_D_fake <= 0 commits the exact plain branch
self_null_condition: a rejected proposal contributes zero parameters, moments, schedulers, streams or RNG state
paired_target_proof: the decision reads only branch-averaged unpaired D_fake; PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS and confirmation identities are absent from the controller interface
expected_valid_states: states whose 8-step observable retains its audited lead relationship
falsification_test: proposal-only, observable-only/plain, and full selector from the same e0; kill if the selector chooses harmful H200 branches or fails the 2400-step late gate
compute_cost: two 8-update branches per committed 8 updates; proposal branch inherits parent-probe cost
memory_cost: one live branch at a time plus one CPU full-state snapshot
pseudocode: commit proposal if direction * (mean(D_fake)_proposal - mean(D_fake)_plain) > 0 else plain
